s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.strategy_id != '999' AND s.channel != '全部' AND s.big_category != '全部' AND s.small_category != '全部'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_sr_strategy product WHERE product.strategy_code = s.strategy_id AND product.tab_type = 'control' AND product.is_deleted = 0 AND product.product_name = #{query.productName})
AND s.tab_type = #{query.tabType}
AND s.strategy_class = #{query.strategyClass}
AND (s.strategy_class = '全部' OR ( s.strategy_class != '全部' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ap all_scope WHERE all_scope.tab_type = 'active' AND all_scope.is_deleted = 0 AND all_scope.strategy_class = '全部' AND all_scope.stat_month = s.stat_month AND all_scope.channel = s.channel AND all_scope.city_id <=> s.city_id AND all_scope.county_id <=> s.county_id AND all_scope.strategy_id != '999' AND all_scope.channel != '全部' AND all_scope.big_category != '全部' AND all_scope.small_category != '全部' ) ))
AND (s.strategy_class = '全部' OR ( s.strategy_class != '全部' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ap all_scope WHERE all_scope.tab_type = 'active' AND all_scope.is_deleted = 0 AND all_scope.strategy_class = '全部' AND all_scope.stat_month = s.stat_month AND all_scope.city_id <=> s.city_id AND all_scope.county_id <=> s.county_id AND all_scope.strategy_id != '999' AND all_scope.channel != '全部' AND all_scope.big_category != '全部' AND all_scope.small_category != '全部' ) ))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_sr_strategy cg WHERE cg.strategy_code = s.strategy_id AND cg.tab_type = 'active' AND cg.strategy_class = '重点客群' AND cg.is_deleted = 0 AND cg.customer_group = #{query.customerGroup})
AND s.city_id = #{query.cityId} AND s.county_id = #{query.countyId} AND (s.channel = #{query.channel} OR s.channel IN (SELECT d.key_code FROM t_sr_dim_channel d WHERE d.key_name = #{query.channel} AND d.status = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND (d.tab_type = #{query.tabType} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{query.tabType}, d.tab_type) > 0))) AND s.big_category = #{query.bigCategory} AND s.small_category = #{query.smallCategory} AND s.strategy_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.strategyName}, '%') AND s.stat_month >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{query.statMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AND s.stat_month < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{query.statMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') AS statMonth,
s.channel AS channel, s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory,
COUNT(DISTINCT s.strategy_id) AS strategyCount,
SUM(s.consult_count) AS consultCount, SUM(s.retain_count) AS retainCount, SUM(s.dispatch_count) AS dispatchCount, SUM(s.success_count) AS successCount, SUM(s.income) AS income
SUM(s.original_cust) AS originalCust, SUM(s.push_count) AS pushCount, SUM(s.usage_count) AS usageCount, SUM(s.reach_count) AS reachCount, SUM(s.target_conv_num) AS targetConvNum, SUM(s.product_conv_num) AS productConvNum, SUM(s.expected_income) AS expectedIncome, SUM(s.actual_income) AS actualIncome, SUM(s.reject_count) AS rejectCount
FROM s WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m')
, s.channel , s.big_category, s.small_category
ORDER BY statMonth
SELECT DAY(MAX(d.stat_date)) FROM t_sr_strategy_daily_ap d WHERE AND DATE_FORMAT(d.stat_date, '%Y-%m') = #{query.statMonth}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.stat_date, '%Y-%m') AS statMonth,
d.channel AS channel, d.big_category AS bigCategory, d.small_category AS smallCategory,
COUNT(DISTINCT d.strategy_id) AS strategyCount, COUNT(DISTINCT d.stat_date) AS dayCount, MIN(DAY(d.stat_date)) AS minDay, MAX(DAY(d.stat_date)) AS maxDay, SUM(d.original_cust) AS originalCust, SUM(d.push_count) AS pushCount, SUM(d.usage_count) AS usageCount, SUM(d.reach_count) AS reachCount, SUM(d.target_conv_num) AS targetConvNum, SUM(d.product_conv_num) AS productConvNum, SUM(d.expected_income) AS expectedIncome, SUM(d.actual_income) AS actualIncome, SUM(d.reject_count) AS rejectCount FROM t_sr_strategy_daily_ap d WHERE AND DATE_FORMAT(d.stat_date, '%Y-%m') IN (#{previousMonth}, #{query.statMonth}) AND DAY(d.stat_date) <= #{cutoffDay} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.stat_date, '%Y-%m')
, d.channel , d.big_category, d.small_category
ORDER BY statMonth

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') AS statMonth, s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory, b.biz_name AS bizName, SUM(b.count) AS capacity FROM t_sr_strategy_biz_capacity b JOIN s ON s.strategy_id = b.strategy_id AND b.tab_type = #{query.tabType} AND s.city_id <=> b.city_id AND s.county_id <=> b.county_id AND DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(b.stat_date, '%Y-%m') WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.biz_name != '全部' AND GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m'), s.big_category, s.small_category, b.biz_name ORDER BY statMonth, capacity DESC
